phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Mk 14 EBR Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 7.62×51mm NATO primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 415 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 415 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 457 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 780 m/s (3350 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Short-Stroke Pulse & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 20-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the Mk 14 EBR staged for its 725 RPM Cyclic (40 RPM Practical Semi-Auto) cadence.

zh.headline: Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR 增强型战斗步枪：2004 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR 应美国海军海豹突击队紧凑型 7.62 NATO 远程火力需求而生：将经典 M14 怀特自调活塞机匣嵌入 Sage CNC 航空铝整体底盘，配备伸缩托、可调贴腮板与全周战术导轨，令冷战名枪焕发 21 世纪精准射手战力。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Mk 14 EBR 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 2004 年问世的 Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR 增强型战斗步枪 由美国美国海军水面作战中心克雷恩分部 / Sage International主导研制，定位为经典的铝合金底盘精确射手步枪。2004 年率先装备美国海军特种作战司令部的 Mk 14 EBR 迅速在阿富汗与伊拉克高山戈壁战场证明了 7.62 mm 班组精确射手的不可替代性。
Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR 应美国海军海豹突击队紧凑型 7.62 NATO 远程火力需求而生：将经典 M14 怀特自调活塞机匣嵌入 Sage CNC 航空铝整体底盘，配备伸缩托、可调贴腮板与全周战术导轨，令冷战名枪焕发 21 世纪精准射手战力。 整件装备总长 889 mm（伸缩托缩回 790 mm）、空重 5.1 kg，成为同期狙击步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。2004 年，美国美国海军水面作战中心克雷恩分部 / Sage International推出了划时代的Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR 增强型战斗步枪。2004 年率先装备美国海军特种作战司令部的 Mk 14 EBR 迅速在阿富汗与伊拉克高山戈壁战场证明了 7.62 mm 班组精确射手的不可替代性。 它的核心设计聚焦于沿用 M14 怀特气体截断自调短行程活塞与双突笋旋转枪机，风沙高温极度可靠，奠定了其在狙击步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR 增强型战斗步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「怀特自调膨胀短行程活塞 · 双突笋旋转闭锁枪机 + CNC 铝底盘」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用哑光航空级钛合金与高强度 CNC 铝合金精加工而成。Sage 航空级 6061 整体 CNC 铝底盘取代胡桃木托，根除受潮移零顽疾，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR 增强型战斗步枪 采用怀特自调膨胀短行程活塞 · 双突笋旋转闭锁枪机 + CNC 铝底盘。在每个击发周期中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方。借助哑光航空级钛合金与高强度 CNC 铝合金工艺与高强度配合，实现了Sage 航空级 6061 整体 CNC 铝底盘取代胡桃木托，根除受潮移零顽疾。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 7.62×51mm NATO 弹药规格与 457 mm（18 in）中重型比赛枪管 · 4 条右旋膛线（1:279 mm），最高工作膛压约 415 MPa，可赋予弹头 780 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,350 J 动能，有效作用距离达 700 米。
内膛技术特点方面，18 in 中重型比赛枪管以高刚度铝底盘刚性锁紧导气箍，大幅收敛谐波散布。同时，18 in 紧凑重管配伸缩导轨托，兼顾山地远射与城镇近战机动性，令其在 725 发/分（理论射速 · 实战半自动 40 发/分） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 457 毫米身管与 7.62×51mm NATO 口径，Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR 增强型战斗步枪 实现了每秒 780 米的初速与 700 米有效射程。18 in 中重型比赛枪管以高刚度铝底盘刚性锁紧导气箍，大幅收敛谐波散布，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 36 mm 膛轴设计，Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR 增强型战斗步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 10.3 N·s 水平。四面 MIL-STD-1913 导轨可同时挂装白光镜、串列夜视仪、激光测距与双脚架。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Mk 14 EBR
paragraphs: Introduced in 2004 by NSWC Crane / Sage International in United States, the Sage Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR emerged as a defining Enhanced Battle Rifle / Designated Marksman Rifle. First fielded by Naval Special Warfare in 2004, the Mk 14 EBR proved the necessity of squad-level 7.62×51mm reach across mountainous engagements in Afghanistan and Iraq.

Created for U.S. Navy SEALs seeking a compact 7.62×51mm precision rifle, the Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR seats a classic M14 White-piston receiver inside a CNC-milled Sage aluminum chassis with telescoping buttstock, adjustable cheekpiece, and quad rails. Measuring 889 mm (790 mm Stock Collapsed) at an unloaded weight of 5.1 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Sniper Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 2004, NSWC Crane / Sage International of United States introduced the Sage Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR. First fielded by Naval Special Warfare in 2004, the Mk 14 EBR proved the necessity of squad-level 7.62×51mm reach across mountainous engagements in Afghanistan and Iraq. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Retains the proven M14 White self-regulating cut-off piston and dual-lug rotating bolt — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Sage Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR sits its White Self-Regulating Short-Stroke Gas Piston · Dual-Lug Rotating Bolt in Billet Aluminum Chassis. Throughout every firing cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver, containing 415 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in matte aerospace titanium alloy and billet aluminum, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, CNC-machined Sage 6061 aluminum chassis eliminates wooden stock bedding drift, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Sage Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR relies on White Self-Regulating Short-Stroke Gas Piston · Dual-Lug Rotating Bolt in Billet Aluminum Chassis. During each cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver. Machined from matte aerospace titanium alloy and billet aluminum, it delivers standout engineering reliability: CNC-machined Sage 6061 aluminum chassis eliminates wooden stock bedding drift.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 7.62×51mm NATO with 457 mm (18 in) Medium-Heavy Match Barrel · 4-Groove RH Rifling (1:279 mm), the Sage Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR develops 780 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,350 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 700 meters.

Internally, 18-inch medium-heavy match barrel locks rigidly into the Sage chassis whip-damping block for repeatable groups. Combined with its 725 RPM Cyclic (40 RPM Practical Semi-Auto) tempo, 18-inch barrel and telescoping rail buttstock balance mountain reach with urban handling, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 7.62×51mm NATO through its 457 millimeter bore, the Sage Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR achieves 780 meters per second and 700 meters of effective reach. 18-inch medium-heavy match barrel locks rigidly into the Sage chassis whip-damping block for repeatable groups.
